description: White button that reacts on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, top becomes 0, left becomes 0.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Silly Yak 73</title>
<style>
/* Silly Yak 73 by kiru2741 — https://uiverse.io/kiru2741/silly-yak-73 */
button {
 padding: 10px;
 font-size: 15px;
 outline: none;
 border: 2px solid black;
 background-color: white;
 color: white;
 position: relative;
 letter-spacing: 1px;
}

button::before {
 content: 'Button';

 position: absolute;
 top: -14%;
 left: 7%;
 background-color: black;
 width: 100%;
 height: 100%;
 color: white;
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 transition: 0.15s ease-in-out;
 font-weight: bold;
}

button:hover::before {
 top: 0;
 left: 0;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
